parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the instance for which you want to configure high-definition second-level monitoring.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The type of the instance. Set the value to **EIP**.

parameters.name: LogProject
parameters.description: The name of the LogProject in Simple Log Service.

parameters.name: LogStore
parameters.description: The name of the LogStore in Simple Log Service.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The high-definition second-level monitoring status of the instance. Valid values:

- **ON**: Enables high-definition second-level monitoring.
- **OFF**: Disables high-definition second-level monitoring.
